Reverse ETL as code — no UI, no lock-in, no per-row bill.

## Usage

```bash
drt [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`build`](build.md) | Run sync(s) and their tests in one invocation (sequential). |
| [`clean`](clean.md) | Clean up orphan __drt_swap shadow tables left by interrupted swaps. |
| [`cloud`](cloud.md) | drt Cloud commands (stub). |
| [`config`](config.md) | Manage user-level drt settings (~/.drt/). |
| [`decrypt`](decrypt.md) | Decrypt secrets.toml.enc with the age identity in DRT_SECRETS_KEY. |
| [`deploy`](deploy.md) | Scaffold CI/CD deployment files for this project. |
| [`destinations`](destinations.md) | List available destination connectors. |
| [`docs`](docs.md) | Generate or serve the project's sync catalog. |
| [`doctor`](doctor.md) | Check environment and report potential issues. |
| [`encrypt`](encrypt.md) | Encrypt secrets.toml with the age identity in DRT_SECRETS_KEY. |
| [`init`](init.md) | Initialize a new drt project in the current directory. |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all sync definitions in the project. |
| [`mcp`](mcp.md) | MCP server commands. |
| [`plugins`](plugins.md) | Inspect installed drt plugins (entry-point extensions). |
| [`profile`](profile.md) | Manage source credential profiles in ~/.drt/profiles.yml. |
| [`retry`](retry.md) | Replay failed records from a sync's Dead Letter Queue. |
| [`run`](run.md) | Run sync(s) defined in the project. |
| [`serve`](serve.md) | Start an HTTP endpoint that triggers drt syncs on demand. |
| [`sources`](sources.md) | List available source connectors. |
| [`state`](state.md) | Inspect and reset drt's durable state (watermarks, run state, mirror keys). |
| [`status`](status.md) | Show the status of the most recent sync runs. |
| [`test`](test.md) | Run post-sync validation tests. |
| [`validate`](validate.md) | Validate sync definitions against the JSON Schema. |
